build_DidAgentsCollide_measure: build a measure to detect if two agents are colliding using discrete collision detection
create_NumAgentsCollide_measure: create a cumulative measure tracking the number of steps agents spend in collision
build_OtherAgentGps_sensor: build a sensor returning the relative GPS coordinates between two agents in the scene
create_AreAgentsWithinThreshold_sensor: create a sensor checking if two agents are within a configurable elliptical threshold distance
build_RearrangeCooperateReward_measure: build a reward measure that penalizes agent collisions and optionally ends the episode
